info.title: kanata
info.description: OpenAI-compatible inference gateway with a private listener and an optional public listener. Both listeners serve the same paths; the public listener serves only allowlisted routes and never private-only providers. Every model and operation is an exact `(model_alias, operation)` route with no fallback, wildcard or retries. Requests accept only the documented members: unknown members and unsupported options return `400 invalid_request` with the member's JSON path in `param` where it can be named safely. Capabilities per model are published under `kanata` on `GET /v1/models`.

servers.description: A Kanata client listener (private or public), without the `/v1` suffix.

base.description: Scheme, host and port of the listener.

tags.name: Responses
tags.description: Stateless OpenAI Responses subset over chat routes.

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Stateless Anthropic Messages subset over chat routes.

get.description: Aliases this key may use on this listener with at least one bound route (the public listener also applies its route allowlist). Listing does not confirm backend health. Responses carry `Cache-Control: no-store`.
Same object as a `GET /v1/models` entry. Unknown ids and ids the key may not use on this listener both return `404 not_found`.

post.description: Exact `(model, chat)` route with no fallback or retries. Requires `Content-Type: application/json`. The body is limited by `limits.max_body_bytes` (requests with audio by the audio envelope).

200.description: A completion, or with `stream: true` a server-sent event stream.

schema.description: `data:` frames each carrying a `ChatCompletionChunk` (see components), ending with `data: [DONE]`. The first chunk carries `delta.role`; tool-call deltas carry `index`, and `id`/`type`/`function.name` on the first fragment. With `stream_options.include_usage` a final chunk with empty `choices` carries `usage`. `: keepalive` comments are sent during silence. A failure after the stream starts is sent as `data: {"error":{...}}` (the error envelope) and the stream ends without `[DONE]`. `Cache-Control: no-cache`.

post.description: Stateless Responses subset over chat routes and scopes; send full history each turn. No stored responses, retrieval, cancellation or hosted tools.

200.description: A response object, or with `stream: true` typed server-sent events.

schema.description: Typed events: `event: <type>` then `data:` JSON with the same `type` and an increasing `sequence_number`. Order: `response.created`, `response.in_progress`, then per item `response.output_item.added`, `response.content_part.added`, `response.output_text.delta` or `response.function_call_arguments.delta`, the matching `.done` events and `response.output_item.done`; private reasoning adds `response.reasoning_summary_part.added`, `response.reasoning_summary_text.delta`, `response.reasoning_summary_text.done` and `response.reasoning_summary_part.done`. Terminal event: `response.completed`, `response.incomplete` (with `incomplete_details.reason`) or `response.failed` (with a sanitized `error`). No `[DONE]` marker; `: keepalive` comments during silence. Output is limited to 8 MiB, 64 function calls and 16 KiB per argument delta.

post.description: Stateless Anthropic Messages subset over chat routes and scopes. Route-level errors use the Anthropic-style envelope with the Kanata `code`. `GET` returns `405` with `Allow: POST`; `/v1/messages/count_tokens` is not implemented.

200.description: A message, or with `stream: true` typed server-sent events.

schema.description: Typed events: `message_start`, then per block `content_block_start`, `content_block_delta` (`text_delta` or `input_json_delta`) and `content_block_stop`, then `message_delta` (stop reason and usage) and `message_stop`. `event: ping` keepalives are sent only after the first upstream event. A failure after the stream starts is sent as `event: error` with the Messages error envelope. A reply with no content sends no content blocks. At most 64 tool calls and 16 KiB per argument delta.

post.description: Exact `(model, transcription)` route. Multipart form; malformed forms return `400 invalid_request` with `param: null`.

file.contentType: audio/wav, audio/x-wav, audio/mpeg, audio/flac, audio/mp4, audio/ogg, audio/webm

200.description: Transcript as JSON (default) or plain text with `response_format=text`.

post.description: Exact `(model, embeddings)` route, with separate key scopes from chat. Streaming is unsupported.

Exact `(model, speech)` route with voice and format allowlists. Returns at most 8 MiB of audio; oversized, truncated or mismatched upstream audio returns `502 upstream_failure`. No token usage is reported.

200.description: Audio bytes with `Cache-Control: no-store` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`.

bearerAuth.description: `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (keys start with `kanata_sk_`). If both `Authorization` and `x-api-key` are sent, each must occur once with the same value. Keys are never accepted in query strings.

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: `x-api-key: <key>`. If both headers are sent, each must occur once with the same value.

XRequestId.description: Request id. On the private listener a valid client `x-request-id` is echoed, otherwise one is generated; the public listener always generates its own.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait. Sent with gateway-side refusals (`gateway_queue_full`, `gateway_key_busy`, `gateway_key_rate_limited`, `daily_quota_exceeded`, `gateway_busy`, `gateway_upload_busy`, and `upstream_unavailable` from an open circuit breaker); absent for upstream `rate_limit_exceeded`, `quota_unavailable` and `server_draining`.

XRequestIdHeader.name: x-request-id
XRequestIdHeader.description: Optional client request id: 1–128 ASCII letters, digits, `-` or `_`, sent at most once. On the private listener, inference endpoints reject an invalid or repeated value with `400 invalid_request` and valid values are echoed in the response header; the public listener ignores the header entirely.

E401.description: Authentication failed. `invalid_api_key` is the private listener's answer to a missing or invalid key; `key_expired` is sent on both listeners. Codes: `invalid_api_key`, `key_expired`.

E403.description: Permission denied. On the public listener this is also the answer to a missing or invalid key. Codes: `permission_denied`.

E408.description: Upload deadline expired or request cancelled. Codes: `request_upload_timeout`, `request_cancelled`.

E413.description: Request body, audio, file or image limits exceeded. Codes: `invalid_request`.

E429.description: Rate limited by the gateway, the key's allowance or the upstream. Codes: `gateway_queue_full`, `gateway_key_busy`, `gateway_key_rate_limited`, `daily_quota_exceeded`, `rate_limit_exceeded`.

MessagesE401.description: Authentication failed. `invalid_api_key` is the private listener's answer to a missing or invalid key; `key_expired` is sent on both listeners. Codes: `invalid_api_key`, `key_expired`.

MessagesE403.description: Permission denied. On the public listener this is also the answer to a missing or invalid key. Public-listener authentication failures use the OpenAI envelope. Codes: `permission_denied`.

MessagesE408.description: Upload deadline expired or request cancelled. Codes: `request_upload_timeout`, `request_cancelled`.

MessagesE413.description: Request body, audio, file or image limits exceeded. Codes: `invalid_request`.

MessagesE429.description: Rate limited by the gateway, the key's allowance or the upstream. Codes: `gateway_queue_full`, `gateway_key_busy`, `gateway_key_rate_limited`, `daily_quota_exceeded`, `rate_limit_exceeded`.

ErrorCode.description:
Kanata `error.code` values. HTTP status and meaning per code:

- `invalid_request`: 400 or 413. Malformed or unsupported request; `param` names the rejected JSON path when it can be named safely. 413 when a body, file or image limit is exceeded.
- `unsupported_operation`: 400. The backend cannot perform the requested operation.
- `invalid_api_key`: 401. Private listener only: missing or invalid key. Carries `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="kanata"`.
- `key_expired`: 401. The key has expired (both listeners). Carries `WWW-Authenticate` with `error="invalid_token"`.
- `permission_denied`: 403. The key may not use this model, operation or effort on this listener; on the public listener also a missing or invalid key.
- `not_found`: 404. Unknown path, unknown or unpermitted model id on `GET /v1/models/{id}`, or an upstream 404.
- `conflict`: 409. Defined by the error contract; not emitted by these endpoints.
- `request_upload_timeout`: 408. The request body did not arrive before the upload deadline.
- `request_cancelled`: 408. The request was cancelled, for example because the client disconnected.
- `rate_limit_exceeded`: 429. The upstream backend is rate-limiting. No gateway `Retry-After`.
- `gateway_queue_full`: 429. The gateway queue for this route or backend is full. Carries `Retry-After`.
- `gateway_key_busy`: 429. The key has too many requests in flight. Carries `Retry-After`.
- `gateway_key_rate_limited`: 429. The key sent too many requests recently. Carries `Retry-After`.
- `daily_quota_exceeded`: 429. The key's daily allowance is exhausted. `Retry-After` points to the next UTC midnight. Error type `quota_error`.
- `internal_error`: 500. Internal gateway error.
- `upstream_failure`: 502. The upstream answered with an invalid, oversized or failed response.
- `upstream_unavailable`: 503. The backend is unavailable, or its circuit breaker is open (then with `Retry-After`).
- `gateway_busy`: 503. No admission slot freed up within the queue time. Carries `Retry-After`.
- `gateway_upload_busy`: 503. Request-buffer capacity is exhausted. Carries `Retry-After: 1`.
- `quota_unavailable`: 503. The daily allowance cannot be reserved durably, or the clock moved to an earlier UTC day. Error type `quota_error`.
- `server_draining`: 503. The server is shutting down and admits no new requests.
- `upstream_timeout`: 504. A connect, header, first-byte, idle, queue or overall deadline expired.

message.description: Fixed, sanitized message; never echoes request or upstream content.

param.description: JSON path of the rejected request member (for example `messages[2].content[0]`), cut at a segment boundary after 128 bytes; `null` when no safe path exists.

ErrorEnvelope.description: OpenAI-compatible error envelope used by every endpoint except route-level `/v1/messages` errors.

type.description: Mapped from the HTTP status: 400/other 4xx `invalid_request_error`, 401 `authentication_error`, 403 `permission_error`, 404 `not_found_error`, 408/504 `timeout_error`, 413 `request_too_large`, 429 `rate_limit_error`, 503 `overloaded_error`, other 5xx `api_error`.

MessagesErrorEnvelope.description: Anthropic-style envelope for route-level `/v1/messages` errors. Public-listener authentication failures happen before routing and keep the OpenAI envelope.

in_flight.description: Live requests running on this route.

queued.description: Live requests waiting for this route.

adapter_in_flight.description: Live requests on the backend; `null` if uncapped.

breaker.description: Circuit breaker state of the backend.

Admission.description: Private listener only. Per-route limits from `[limits]`/`[timeouts]` plus a live load snapshot. A snapshot, not a health guarantee.

operations.description: Operations this key may use on this alias and listener.

sampling_controls.description: Chat accepts `temperature`, `top_p`, `seed` and enforces max-token fields.

reasoning_efforts.description: Efforts the key may request, when enumerated; otherwise `null`.

context_tokens.description: Declared context window, or `null` for the provider's full window.

max_output_tokens.description: Declared output cap; larger requested limits are rejected (Messages clamps).

responses.description: Present for aliases with a chat route.

messages.description: Present for aliases with a chat route.

embeddings.description: Present for aliases with an embeddings route.

speech.description: Present for aliases with a speech route.

KanataModel.description: Kanata capability extension. Describes gateway configuration for this key and listener, not live backend health. Capability flags come from the alias's chat route and are `false` for aliases without one.

id.description: Model alias. Grouped reasoning models list one base id.

Extensions.description: Namespaced extension values (`vendor.key`, lowercase segments of letters, digits and `-`; key at most 128 bytes). At most 16 entries, nesting depth 4 and 8 KiB serialized (or the configured lower limit). Each key must be allowlisted on the route and adapter, otherwise `400 invalid_request`.

ChatInputAudioPart.description: User messages only, on models with `kanata.input_audio`. Decoded audio across the request is limited by `limits.max_audio_bytes` (at most 25 MiB); over the limit returns 413.

url.description: Inline PNG or JPEG data URL; remote URLs are rejected.

ChatImagePart.description: User messages only, on models with `kanata.input_images`. At most 4 images, 4 MiB each, 8 MiB total, 4096 px per side, 16,777,216 pixels total; limits return 413.

reasoning_content.description: Assistant only: replayed plaintext reasoning, at most 256 KiB.

ChatMessage.description: System and developer messages need nonempty text. User messages need text, audio or image content. Assistant messages need text or `tool_calls`; an assistant turn with empty content and no calls is a replayed empty answer and is dropped. Tool messages need `tool_call_id` and `content` (empty allowed). Audio and image parts are user-only.

parameters.description: JSON Schema object; forwarded, not enforced.

ChatTool.description: Function tool; names must be unique.

schema.description: At most 64 KiB serialized and 32 levels deep.

StopSequences.description: At most 4 sequences of 1–256 bytes. Rejected on routes whose backend does not take stop sequences.

Penalty.description: Rejected on routes whose backend does not take penalties.

MaxTokens.description: At most `kanata.max_output_tokens` when set. Validated then dropped on routes without `sampling_controls`.

max_completion_tokens.description: Alternative to `max_tokens`; sending both is rejected.

reasoning_effort.description: Requires `kanata.reasoning_control`; must be in `kanata.reasoning_efforts` when enumerated.

chat_template_kwargs.description: Only `enable_thinking`, on backends that accept it and without `reasoning_effort`; not `null`.

prompt_cache_key.description: 1–64 printable ASCII bytes; forwarded where supported, dropped elsewhere.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: Unknown members and `null` option values return `400 invalid_request` with the member's JSON path in `param`.

prompt_tokens_details.description: Private listener only, when reported upstream.

content.description: `""` for a reply with no output.

reasoning_content.description: Private listener only, when the backend returns reasoning (at most 256 KiB).

choices.description: Empty on the final usage chunk.

ChatCompletionChunk.description: One `data:` payload of a chat completion stream.

ResponsesFunctionCall.description: Call ids must be unique and each must be answered by a later `function_call_output`.

encrypted_content.description: Replayed in order on routes that support it, dropped elsewhere.

ResponsesTool.description: Flat function declaration; other tool types return `param=tools[i]`.

include.description: Encrypted reasoning is returned only on the private listener.

client_metadata.description: At most 16 KiB of keys and values; accepted and dropped.

ResponsesRequest.description: Stateless subset over chat routes. `previous_response_id`, `conversation`, `service_tier`, `prompt`, `stream_options` and any other member return `400 invalid_request` with `param`.

items.description: `message` (with `output_text` content), `function_call` or, on the private listener, `reasoning` items.

Response.description: Echoes request options (`tools`, `tool_choice`, `temperature`, `top_p`, `max_output_tokens`, `reasoning`, `text`, `truncation`). Ids are not retrieval handles.

MessagesImageBlock.description: User turns only; image limits as for chat.

MessagesMessage.description: Text blocks must be nonempty; an assistant turn with only empty text is dropped.

MessagesTool.description: Client tool; `type` optional. Hosted/server tool types return `param=tools[i]`.

max_tokens.description: Required; clamped to the route cap.

thinking.description: `enabled` (a thinking budget) is rejected with `param=thinking`. No thinking blocks are emitted.

output_config.description: `effort` applies only where the alias has reasoning control; `format` is rejected.

MessagesRequest.description: Stateless Anthropic Messages subset over chat routes. Unknown members return 400 with `param`.

content.description: `[]` for a reply with no text or tool calls.

input_tokens.description: Excludes cached input; unreported counts are 0.

dimensions.description: Must be supported by the model; `dimensions` × inputs at most 262,144.

EmbeddingsRequest.description: Unknown members (including `user`) return 400; deserialization failures here carry `param: null`.

file.description: Audio part with a safe filename (≤255 bytes, no path separators) and an explicit content type: `audio/wav`, `audio/x-wav`, `audio/mpeg`, `audio/flac`, `audio/mp4`, `audio/ogg` or `audio/webm`. At most `limits.max_audio_bytes` (25 MiB by default).

TranscriptionRequest.description: Each field at most once; text fields have no control characters. Other fields are rejected with `400 invalid_request` (`param: null`).

input.description: Nonblank; at most 4,096 characters and 16,384 UTF-8 bytes. `[pause:`, `[voice:` and `[rate:` controls are rejected.
